[[Jahmeh Bahkmasitur]] is a [[Vabbi]]an citizen found in the plaza.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Forum Highlands}} (on a higher platform, west of the [[Font of Lyss]])

==Dialogue==
:''"Prices are up, costs are down, and demand is high. At this rate, we'll be shipping in materials from the far edges of the world just to keep up!"'' 

==Quotes==
:''"Congratulate yourselves, everyone! For the first time, you've done it again!"''
:''"My daughter just brought back a shipment of [[silk]]s from [[Cantha]]... gorgeous. Give me a day, and they'll be in my shop. Another day and they'll be gone!"''

==Trivia==
*Presumably named after Jamie Buckmaster, a contributor of the [[Guild Wars]] Alpha Test program and one of the founders of Knights Templar guild.
